$comment: Pins the DataOps image raises past the plus edition it installs.
The distribution tarball (`sparkelf-dsh-plus-<version>.tgz`) is the reviewed release;
its intranet-team edition pins every plugin once. A plugin fix that ships in a new
package version is pinned here and rewritten into the tarball's own metadata before
`dsh-plus install`, so the profile projection, the global install and the profile
dependency table all resolve the same reviewed version. The plus edition is not
republished for a DataOps-only pin: this file, the image build and the profile stay one
reviewable change, and every entry is asserted after install.
String values are npm dependency specifiers (`1.2.3` or `npm:@scope/name@1.2.3` for an
alias). An object with `source: "tarball"` installs the vendored file instead and records
its sha256; that form exists only when the package cannot be published to the registry yet,
and the build must say so instead of claiming a registry release.
